newsitem.title: UK: Turkish Halkbank plans debut 150 mln mark Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Halkbank plans debut 150 mln mark Eurobond.

text.p: Turkey's state-run Turkiye Halk Bankasi (Halkbank) plans to issue a 150 million mark Eurobond next week, an official at lead manager UBS said on Wednesday.

"Halkbank will hold a roadshow in Frankfurt next Wednesday, and a bond will follow shortly after," a syndicate manager at UBS told Reuters. "A five-year maturity is expected, although Halkbank may opt for three years."
Spread talk was around 300 basis points over Bunds, he said.
J.P. Morgan and UBS will be joint lead managers of the bond, Halkbank's first venture into the Eurobond market.
Halkbank has already raised funds via the syndicated loan market, where it borrowed $150 million at two years last June.
The bank acts as a development bank to small and medium businesses, the UBS official said.
